title: What If Every Ant on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every ant on Earth vanished? Their weight beats all wild birds and mammals combined.
There are about 20 quadrillion ants, and together they weigh more than every wild bird and mammal.
Without them, soil stops being aerated. Ants dig and turn the ground across most land on Earth.
Plants that rely on ants to carry their seeds would spread less, and some plants shelter ants for protection.
Ants prey on other insects, so pest numbers would boom, and birds that follow ant swarms to find prey would lose a food source.
They break down organic material and make habitat for other animals. The ground itself would change.
